entities.name: Saint Anne Round Church in Kallósd
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Being one of the few round churches from the Árpád Age, the Saint Anne Church in Kallósd is listed among the most significant monuments of Hungary. Every year several tourists visit the church and the little village of less than a hundred inhabitants in one of the side valleys of River Zala.
